BiblicalUsage: Jehoshabath is Jehoshabeath, an Israelitess, the daughter of Jehoram who hid Joash from Athaliah. In 2 Chronicles 22:11, Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jehoshabeath matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
